preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of cities n is between 3 and 10^6 inclusive.
The size of the subset q is between 3 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == minimum number of roads to demolish for test case i
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the minimum number of roads that need to be demolished to ensure that for any subset of size q, there is at least one pair of cities without a direct road between them.
